div.head: Wl art 6
div.ab: Decretum est etiam ibi, ut, si Francigena appellaverit Anglum de periurio aut mordro, furto, homicidio, rán, quod Angli dicunt apertam rapinam quae negari non potest, Anglus se defendat per quod melius voluerit, aut iudicio ferri aut duello.

It has likewise been decreed that, if a Frenchman summon an Englishman for perjury or murder, theft, homicide or "ran," by which the English mean open robbery which cannot be denied, the Englishman shall defend himself by whichever method he prefers, either the ordeal of iron or trial by combat.
